annotations.title: Ask the callee for one more minute to answer the agent's question

description:
Get one more minute to answer the voice agent's pending question: the request is passed to the voice agent, which asks the callee. Compliance: the extension happens ONLY if the callee agrees; the voice agent asks them politely and never makes anyone wait more than 2 minutes in total for one question.

    Use it as soon as get_call shows a pending_question you cannot answer yourself (you need to ask your human): call hold_call_question first, then ask your human. Once per question (+60 seconds). The voice agent asks the callee "can you hold for another minute, or shall I call you back?": if they agree, pending_question.seconds_left grows by 60; if they would rather be called back, the agent arranges a callback and your answer, sent later with answer_call_question, is given at the callback. Follow it with get_call (event question_hold: accepted, callee_prefers_callback or not_possible). Not for a finished call, nor when you already know the answer (just answer).

call_id.description: The call_id of the live call whose voice agent is waiting for an answer.
call_id.title: Call Id

question_id.description: pending_question.question_id from get_call. Omit for the question currently pending.
